cost_surface.method: transaction-cost x turnover grid on the shipped equal-weight BAB default; costed Sharpe must be non-increasing in the cost level at every (seed, turnover) cell

provenance.fixture_recipe: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P35 wide-universe recipe). BTC prices from tests/fixtures/wide_bab_universe.csv. Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, idio ~ N(0, 0.003), betas linspace(0.35, 1.9, 40). Not real market data; not market profitability evidence.
